episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with Pepito's sign-on and a Matt Liddell temporary-tattoo sub-goal tease before Blackwell and Ripple delivered a grim day-13 Iran war rundown — triple-tap apartment strikes, 3.2 million displaced, Strait of Hormuz tanker attacks, and Iran's peace terms demanding reparations. Hype Train derailed subscriptions into a rap threatening a Matt Liddell face tattoo. Munch & Crum debated royal vs. pop-couple fight supremacy, with Crum winning on chat timing and citing newfound super-strength from his post-hell fugue state. Rick and Jeff hosted a chaotic town hall confirming they are separate entities, fielding questions on noids, gorilla grip strength, and Brandon's mom's secret name. The broadcast closed with Brandon playing Ace Attorney's first turnabout under his mother's new 250-character throat-protection limit, securing a not-guilty verdict via Paris time-zone clock evidence and revealing his rotten-sinks OnlyFans side hustle.
